payload.text: **Re-read the inbox immediately before a bats run, not once at pickup.** 2026-09-17: vc's 'a full suite is running, hold yours' sat unread while dc ran 17 bats runs over 25 minutes; dc had checked the inbox before starting the campaign and treated that as covering the whole of it. No harm landed -- separate TMPDIRs, and vc's plan came back 1..1370 with nothing lost -- but the instruction was to hold. A check before the first run does not cover a campaign that runs for half an hour.
